mechanism_extracted.claim_1: A same-date cross-sectional design identifies ONE implementation's private response at the prevailing level of aggregate positioning. The date effect that makes the comparison robust to market-wide shocks absorbs the strategy's own accumulated crowding EXACTLY, because that crowding is common to the implementations being compared.
mechanism_extracted.claim_2: A trial of FIXED length understates the eventual capacity effect, because deployed capital erodes the edge gradually. Reaching the aggregate effect requires implementations with deliberately different exposure, or variation in aggregate positioning over time.
mechanism_extracted.desk_relevance: libs/research/crowding.py takes exactly the same-date residual (rate minus the same-instant cross-section) and its docstring already claims the split ('level is the market; residual is ours'). The paper CONFIRMS the split is real and prices what it costs: the residual arm is provably blind to cohort-wide crowding, and no amount of accrual fixes that. The desk's forward window is a FIXED 14 days (L1.58), so any capacity erosion measured across it is a LOWER BOUND on the eventual effect.
mechanism_extracted.l1_6_note: This is an attenuation CORRECTION (measured effect understates truth), never a bar loosening. No in-sample threshold, Sharpe bar or fitness grade was imported from any artifact this session.

findings_confirmed.title: MT5 crowding miner dead 9 days on a permanent, self-repeating IndexError
findings_confirmed.evidence: desks/mt5/logs/crowding_miner.log last two lines are cycle error: IndexError('list index out of range') at 2026-08-25T14:55 and 15:55, then silence; crowding_history.jsonl last row 2026-08-25T13:55.
findings_confirmed.root_cause: gh.get('top_stars', [0])[0] -- when a GitHub query returns zero results the key is PRESENT as [], so the [0] default never applies and indexing raises. Four sibling expressions (lines 98/101/102/104) already carry the (... or [0])[0] guard; lines 97 and 105 do not.
findings_confirmed.permanence: the query rotation index is deterministic and the query strings are fixed, so the failing cycle recurs forever -- not a transient

findings_confirmed.title: The MT5 book has zero market-data crowding/capacity instrument, and the fence that would say so reports a false accrual promise
findings_confirmed.evidence: check_crowding.py --json returns status FLAT-BOOK, rc=2, n_snapshots=331, universe_width=875, tape_last=2026-08-20T20:07:04Z. The sole feed is collect_funding_cross_section.py -> Binance USD-M premiumIndex (venue 'binance_usdm'), permanently banned ground under LAWS 1. data/RECORDERS_OFF set 2026-08-25.
findings_confirmed.defect: next_action reads 'book is flat; the tape keeps accruing so the measure is live the day a position opens' -- false in both clauses. The tape cannot accrue (collector idled, universe retired) and an MT5 position can never appear in a perp held-book. WS-005 class: unmeasurable-because-retired renders identically to unmeasurable-because-not-yet.
findings_confirmed.distinct_organ_checked: desks/mt5/research/crowding_miner.py is NOT a substitute: it measures GitHub stars and Reddit post counts for a mechanism KEYWORD (edge_publicity/expected_decay). It never touches price, fills, financing or the desk's own positions, so it cannot detect a competitor on the desk's names. It is also dead (s49-F1).
